title: Character
description: A playable class. PURE DATA describing the starting configuration of a run: max HP, base energy per turn, the starting relic, and the starting deck (a flat list of card ids drawn from the existing card content). 'signature_cards' flags the class-defining cards (the unique starter attack(s), e.g. Bash for the Ironclad) and must be a subset of starting_deck. This schema is the generation contract: starting_relic and every card id reference existing content -- a character never introduces new cards or relics inline, it composes the published ones.

max_energy.description: Base energy per turn before relic bonuses.

starting_relic.description: Relic id granted at run start. Must reference an existing relic.

starting_deck.description: Ordered list of card ids dealt as the opening deck (repeats allowed, e.g. 5x strike). Each must reference an existing card.

signature_cards.description: The class-defining cards (e.g. Bash). Metadata only; must be a subset of starting_deck.

source.description: Provenance tag. LLM-generated content is quarantined for review before promotion.
